scope: formal fixed-panel development evaluation; CTRP sealed
drug_selection_rule: all eight drugs in the original coverage-frozen panel, preserving exact rank/IDs and dose windows; no performance selection or replacement
global_fold_rule: tissue-stratified known biological groups; same global outer/inner partitions for all drugs and models within repeat
endpoint: GDSC2 drug-response AUC within frozen exact drug-specific dose interval; higher = lower sensitivity
tuning_objective: minimum pooled inner OOF RMSE on original GDSC AUC; deterministic first-candidate tie break

feature.annotation_rule: exact-annotation protein_coding only, no full-development or external distribution filter
feature.rank: training log2TPM MAD descending, stable gene-ID tie break
feature.reo_encoding: raw-TPM exact order +1/-1, ties=0; missing is never a tie
feature.missing_rule: finite complete TPM only; fail and record unsupported missing inputs
feature.empty_feature_fallback: training mean, preserving failure and all test samples

elastic_net.path_rule: each fit computes alpha_max from its own training-standardized, tissue-projected X and y, divided by n*l1_ratio; never use outer training or held-out labels to supply an inner path
elastic_net.standardization: train-only feature mean/SD and target mean/population SD
elastic_net.tissue_handling: unpenalized FWL tissue effects after gene/REO construction; unseen tissue effect=0, retaining molecular prediction

random_forest.pair_filter_rule: train-only absolute within-tissue association with continuous response, stable feature-name tie break; apply frozen selected columns to validation/test
random_forest.tissue_handling: append full train-fit one-hot tissue to raw logTPM or raw REO features; unseen category all-zero; no raw-TPM gene residualization

timing_preflight: completed v0.2 two-drug engineering pilot; not an additional outcome-driven search
external_response_access: forbidden; CTRP response, curve index and old response table remain sealed
primary_comparison: REO EN200 versus strong expression EN2000 on identical OOF identities; RF within-family comparison is secondary
statistical_inference: config/formal_statistics_v1.json and docs/FORMAL_ANALYSIS_PROTOCOL.md; paired global biological-group conditional bootstrap
cross_run_interpretation: Formal v1 uses cancer cohort v2 and the same v0.2 models/path; outer folds and repeats differ, so pilot-to-formal changes are not evidence of a model improvement
planned_full_analysis: current fixed8 formal; CTRP remains sealed
failure_policy: Preserve existing recorded mean/zero molecular fallback; finite solver warnings remain eligible and flagged. Record all unhandled exceptions as failed task and stop; do not drop tasks or invent successful predictions. Resume explicitly with the same frozen inputs.
